name: webpdf
description: Read PDFs in the browser: a Rust core that renders pages to SVG with real text, and the viewer that draws them

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:demo
scripts.build:pages: npm run build && node scripts/no-jekyll.ts dist/demo
scripts.test:core: if [ -d .rustup ]; then export RUSTUP_HOME="$PWD/.rustup"; fi; if [ -d .cargo ]; then export CARGO_HOME="$PWD/.cargo"; fi; cargo test --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:browser
